name: generative-media-core
description: SamurAIGPT Generative Media Skills — muapi.ai platform core scripts for AI image, video, audio and workflow generation

structure.core/platform/setup.sh: Configure muapi API key and test auth
structure.core/platform/check-result.sh: Poll or wait for async prediction results
structure.core/media/upload.sh: Upload media assets to muapi CDN
structure.schema_data.json: Model registry with endpoints, parameters and capabilities

install.step1: Install muapi CLI: npm install -g muapi (or pip install muapi)
install.step4: Set env: export MUAPI_KEY=your_key (or add to .env)

security_review.notes: All scripts are thin CLI wrappers around muapi binary. No remote code execution, no eval of network content, no obfuscated code. python3 calls are safe JSON encoding only.
